engine.name: RICHFISH Condition Engine
engine.principle: Separate environmental condition fit from evidence confidence. Missing inputs reduce confidence rather than being silently replaced with invented values.
engine.note: Condition Fit is environmental suitability, not catch probability. Data Confidence is evidence quality/coverage, not catch probability.
